title: Gecko accepts non-conforming full-width digits in <input type="number">
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

# Summary

Gecko (Firefox) currently accepts and normalizes full-width digits (e.g. U+FF10–U+FF19) in `<input type="number">`.  
This appears to diverge from the HTML specification, which requires the value to conform to the [valid floating-point number](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#valid-floating-point-number) — i.e., using only ASCII digits, plus and minus signs, decimal points, and "e"/"E" for exponent notation.

In contrast, Chrome and Safari both reject full-width numerals and do not treat them as valid input.

---

# Related issue

This issue is intended to complement and separate concerns from:  
🔗 [#11395: Normalize full-width digits and similar characters in `<input type="number">`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11395)

That issue discusses **whether** such input should be accepted and normalized at the implementation level, whereas this issue focuses on **what the current specification requires**, and **whether Gecko's behavior is conforming or not**.

---

# Tentative WPT snippet (not yet submitted to WPT)

Below is a tentative WPT-style test for `<input type="number">` with full-width digits and symbols:

```html
<!-- input-type-number-rejects-non-ascii-digits.tentative.html -->
<script>
    test(() => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'number';
        input.value = '２３４'; // full-width digits
        assert_equals(input.value, '', 'Full-width digits should not be accepted');
    }, 'Reject full-width digits (U+FF12 etc) in input[type=number]');
</script>
```

## Console results

| Firefox 141 | Chrome 140 | Safari 18.4 |
|-------------|------------|------------|
| ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7dde811f-38c3-495e-93a8-13b1e9cd9447) | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7d501e00-3bfd-442d-a201-8d7bde3a872a) | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc5ccc93-e586-4c42-b9ab-74d8b33b006f) |

---

This issue seeks clarification on whether normalization of full-width digits is conforming behavior, or whether such input must be explicitly rejected in number inputs. A consistent interpretation would improve interoperability across browsers.

Once clarified, I plan to submit the WPT test formally to reflect the agreed behavior and help maintain alignment across implementations.
